title: Weight loss due to any digestive disorder
summary: Documented weight loss due to any digestive disorder, with BMI ≤17.50 calculated on at least two evaluations at least 60 days apart within a consecutive 6-month period, despite continuing treatment.

children.criterion: Documented digestive disorder causing weight loss
BMI ≤17.50 on at least two evaluations at least 60 days apart within a consecutive 6-month period, despite continuing treatment
